svg.title: Scoring map
svg.text: Chance a shot scores against a computer goalie as in games, best aim (Genesis, played in the real game)
Average shooter (working Shot Power 20, Shot Accuracy 15), standing; the goalie placed as recorded ones were at a release. Each square: one spot, 200+ shots per aim.
Wrist shot: top net (attacking up the screen)
Slapshot: top net (attacking up the screen)
Wrist shot: bottom net (attacking down the screen)
Slapshot: bottom net (attacking down the screen)
Numbers at the left of each panel: units from the goal line (about 3 to a foot). Blue line: the blue line.
Arrows: the d-pad direction to hold as you shoot, the best of the nine aims (dot: nothing held); shown where it
scores 3% or more. Up aims high, Down along the ice, Left / Right at the screen's sides, at both nets.
Grey: no real shot there (the puck would start within the goalie's reach).
